newsitem.title: USA: Baker Hughes sees growing oil demand.
newsitem.headline: Baker Hughes sees growing oil demand.

text.p: Baker Hughes Inc said it expects oil demand to continue to grow, even at a price of $17 to $21 per barrel, and expects this demand to drive the need for more drilling in 1997.
"We believe the resurgence in exploration and development will continue," said Max Lukens, chief executive officer.

"Growing worldwide demand for oil should drive the need for more drilling, even at oil prices of $17 to $21 per barrel. We expect that our customers plan to spend more on their E&P (exploration and production) programs through 1997."
The company earlier reported higher fourth quarter and 1996 year earnings and revenues. It said worldwide drilling activity increased three percent for the year.
